title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a fast‑paced 1970 show featuring a blistering Friend Of The Devil and energetic New Speedway Boogie, though the three‑track split of the latter irks some listeners.
ai_review.review: Listeners rave about this May 14 1970 performance for its lively tempo, especially the rapid acoustic/electric rendition of Friend Of The Devil and the spirited New Speedway Boogie. The soundboard source is generally clear and enjoyable, but the post‑production decision to split New Speedway Boogie into three separate tracks breaks the flow for a few fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong show praise (fast pacing, standout songs) combined with generally good soundboard quality; minor track‑splitting issue lowers the rating slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and balanced audio overall; the only notable complaint is the artificial division of New Speedway Boogie into three tracks, which disrupts continuity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A brisk, early‑1970 set that keeps a lively momentum; fans appreciate the fast tempos compared to later slower periods.
